records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Cedar Collective!
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Reply any time.

Best,

draft.subject: A hand getting Cedar Collective started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

I know a few notes from us have landed in your inbox this week, so I'll keep this one short.

Nothing's set up on Cedar Collective's Wrenfield account yet, and that's usually just a matter of where to begin. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so one real project is normally the useful first step.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you, or to answer anything over email if that's easier.

Best,
Nadia
